component.name: RDPilot
component.summary: Fast RDP client backed by FreeRDP

description.p: RDPilot is a fast remote desktop client backed by FreeRDP. It focuses on responsive sessions, dynamic resolution, secure saved profiles, and a clean tabbed interface.

ul.li: Dynamic resolution that follows the client window as it is resized
Low-latency keyboard and mouse input with mouse-move coalescing
Multiple simultaneous sessions in tabs, with background sessions kept connected
Saved connection profiles, with passwords kept in the system keyring rather than on disk
Text clipboard synchronisation between the local and remote desktop
Per-connection and global quality settings for colour depth, compression, bitmap cache, connection type, and desktop visual effects
Certificate prompts with a persistent trust store

description.p: Keyboard grab is not available on Linux, so shell chords such as Super or Alt+Tab act on the local desktop. A toolbar action sends Ctrl+Alt+Del to the remote session.
Display scaling and full-screen reveal fixes.
